cc:Work.dc:title: Frozen LFW operating points on LSDB clean-impostor scores
cc:Work.dc:description: Histograms and KDE curves of the LSDB ordered impostor pairs (n=756) with the frozen LFW operating points overlaid; cross-database transfer visualization, not recalibration. Thresholds: tau_accept=67.033255206455, tau_reject=140.13, sface standalone=1.0306278467178, deployed=1.0313.
